Name: Frontend Checkout and Pricing Page Update
Description: Jordan will start on the frontend using Stripe Elements for the checkout process. The checkout form must match the app's design, handle potential errors gracefully (e.g., invalid card details, insufficient funds), and provide clear notifications. The pricing page must be updated to reflect the new subscription tiers (Basic $29/mo, Pro $49/mo, Enterprise $99/mo) with a clear feature comparison, a prominent checkout button, and a tooltip/help icon explaining what happens if a user chooses a different plan later. Deadline: within the next 2 weeks.

Name: User Dashboard Frontend Development
Description: Jordan will develop the user dashboard to display current plan details and billing info, provide options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscriptions, allow access to invoices and payment history, and enable updating payment methods. The dashboard must be intuitive, reflect real-time subscription status, and notify users of any changes (e.g., successful plan upgrades, payment failures). Deadline: within the next 2 weeks.

Name: Backend Stripe API Integration and Webhook Setup
Description: Taylor will integrate Stripe's API to handle creating and managing subscriptions, processing payments (successful and failed), and managing webhooks. Specific webhook events to handle include: `invoice.payment_succeeded` (confirm payment and activate/continue subscription), `invoice.payment_failed` (notify user to update payment info and send an email notification), and `customer.subscription.deleted` (update access rights and offer a chance to re-subscribe). Taylor will also document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers. Deadline: within the next 2 weeks.

Name: Frontend-Backend Subscription Integration
Description: Jordan will integrate the frontend components with the backend API to ensure that any changes to the subscription are reflected in real-time on the dashboard. This includes handling errors during the integration process and providing clear notifications to users (e.g., clear instructions if a payment fails). Jordan will coordinate with Taylor to ensure the frontend matches the backend. Deadline: within the next 2 weeks.

Name: Subscription Flow Test Plan and Execution
Description: Taylor will prepare a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests and share it with the team. The testing should cover the whole subscription flow from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription, including specific test scenarios to simulate different webhook events (e.g., payment failures, cancellations). The testing phase will occur in the week following the initial 2-week integration period.

Name: User Documentation and FAQ Creation
Description: The team will create user documentation and support materials, including a help section or FAQ covering common issues and questions about subscriptions. Clear instructions should be available for users on how to manage their subscriptions, access invoices, and handle any issues once the system is live.

Name: Schedule Follow-up Meeting
Description: Alex will set up a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the Stripe integration and address any issues or blockers that come up.
